product_one_liner.value: Trackforce provides a physical-security operations and workforce-management platform for security guard companies and enterprise security teams, covering scheduling, patrols, incident reporting, and billing.

pricing_page.notes: Pricing request page exists but provides customized quotes rather than published prices.

named_customers.notes: Both are named as customer case studies.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn and Inc. list company size as 201–500.

hq_location.notes: Contact page lists Southlake, Texas; LinkedIn company profile lists headquarters in the United States.

founded_year.notes: Company profile identifies 2000 as founding year.

eng_blog.notes: Blog listing is marketing and product-oriented; it does not show the required two engineering/build-focused posts.

public_docs.notes: Public help center contains product articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Current listed openings include Enterprise Sales Director and Major Accounts Account Manager, neither is an AI/ML/data-science role.

model_provider.notes: Reviewed public trust/security information; it refers to AI features but does not name the AI model or provider.

compliance_certs.notes: The trust page also mentions ISO 27017, which is excluded because the requested certification list is limited to SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR, and PCI DSS.

last_funding.notes: The September 2019 announcement said K1 committed over $150 million; later funding profile identifies that as the latest round.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest listed round dates to September 2019, outside the 18-month window before 2026-11-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current openings shown are Enterprise Sales Director and Major Accounts Account Manager; neither matches SDR, BDR, sales/business development representative, or account executive.

launched_6mo.notes: The latest identified product/feature announcements are the Q1 2026 TrackTik update (January 23, 2026) and ReportPro AI launch (September 25, 2025), both before the six-month window starting May 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Scott Kaine was appointed CEO on January 12, 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: No readable job-post, docs, or integration page naming CRM or sales/marketing systems was found in the reviewed sources.
